newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Chirana SKK 8.1mln 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Chirana SKK 8.1mln 1996 net profit.

text.p: Chirana Prema a.s., Slovakia's largest medical equipment maker, said on Thursday it posted a 1996 after-tax profit of 8.1 million crowns ($253,000), after a 5.2 million crown net profit in 1995.
The company has operating revenues of 1.69 billion crowns but company officials said financial operations bit heavily into its bottom line.
"Chirana carried out expensive financial activities in the last year which resulted in the relatively low net profit," Jaromir Jezko, head of Chirana's planning department told Reuters.
He said the largest of such transactions in 1996 was the purchase of an unspecified stake in the country's biggest shipbuilder Slovenske Lodenice a.s..
Last August, Chirana Prema together with its subsidiary Chirana Import-Export took a stake of some 30 percent in Lodenice (SLK).

Chirana Prema is 14-percent owned by the Central European Growth Fund Plc. Other major shareholders include Slovenska Kapitalova a Konzultacna Spolocnost (SKKS) and Brema s.r.o., each with 11.6-percent stake.
The main production of Chirana are stomatological equipment and disposable syringes.
Note. All figures are in millions of Slovak crowns.
-- Peter Javurek, Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402 ($ = 31.90 Czech Crowns)
